title: MARS Command
description: MAARS Command - Autonomous AI Enterprise Operating System | 458+ AI Agents, 13 LLM Providers

headings.text: Everything You Need to Command AI
From Zero to AI Command Center in Minutes

paragraphs: The world's first enterprise-grade AI workforce platform. Chat with 458+ specialists, command them in parallel, and govern every action with live trust scoring — across 33 providers and 175,000+ models.
Pre-built expert agents across 28 networks — engineering, finance, legal, creative, and more.
609 curated models + all of HuggingFace's open-source catalogue via universal pass-through.
Multiple agents working in concert across 28 specialized networks to tackle complex goals.
Natural conversation with 458+ context-aware AI agents, each with unique expertise and tools.
Every action governed, metered, and audited. Agent trust scores built from live execution history.
Single OpenAI-compatible endpoint for all 33 providers. Drop-in replace base_url and you're done.
Three steps to a fully operational AI workforce — no DevOps, no infrastructure, no model juggling.
Sign up and receive your maars-sk key. One credential, universal access — 33 providers, 175,000+ models, all 458 agents.
Chat with any of the 458 pre-built specialists or build custom agents with your own persona, tools, and knowledge base.
